description: Reset a user's password via the admin API. Looks up the user by email, then resets their password. Returns a temporary password if email is not configured, or sends a reset email.

email.description: Email of the user to reset

password.description: New password to set (optional — if omitted, a secure temporary password is generated)

project.description: The project to act on: a registered project's name (rebase_project_list), or a Rebase Cloud project's slug or id. Optional when the session's directory is linked to the intended project. Refused when it names a different project than the directory's link.

name: rebase_auth_reset_password
